title: Guided video observations
details: New Video Observation and Video Witness Testimony methods sit alongside the existing written observation
Record a timestamped unit introduction first, then choose LOs in any order and save each LO as its own dated video file
Use compact full, half and empty circle competence decisions, with an action box only when actions or further evidence are needed
Exact 100% AC wording matches are automatically linked to other units as mapped supporting evidence without copying competence
Video capture is reduced for mobile storage, with a soft warning near 10 minutes and no forced stop
Completed video observations create a timestamped signed PDF and compressed ZIP containing every video clip
